nodeCompatibilityContext.note: Status records describe Node compatibility expectations, not nts expected failures. Event-isTrusted is a named descriptor-shape exclusion under the nts no-descriptors rule; trust behavior has active local controls. The Node runner uses runJsTests, so HTML file absence from status is not evidence of a Node pass.
